purpose: Retrospective execution observations; not scientific decisions or an amendment of frozen source records.
resolved_failures: The initial Crossref request for offset 1000 timed out during proxy/TLS connection. The collector gained per-page checkpoints and the resumed two-page bibliography request succeeded. No 429 response was observed.

Two publisher Abstract extractions initially failed: Ultrastrong coupling between light and matter uses Abs2; Quantum states and intertwining phases in kagome materials uses an Abstracts heading. Distinct supplementary observations preserve the earlier metadata, and both abstracts were subsequently obtained, read and excluded.

The initially assumed /natrevphys/content-types URL returned 404. The actual Content Types link was read from the official directory footer: /natrevphys/content. The configuration uses the verified URL.
The first local browser-tab call timed out. Browser inventory was refreshed and the same in-app browser successfully displayed the final local preview.
